Built the edit profile screen at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

What it includes:
- **Profile photo**: an `Avatar` with a drag-and-drop zone plus a "Change photo" button (PNG/JPG, up to 5MB), built from `@strata/react`'s `DropZone`/`FileTrigger`.
- **Fields**: Full name, Email, Phone (both forced LTR since they're always Latin-script data, even in the Arabic locale), Date of birth (`DatePicker`), and Preferred language (`Select`, with Arabic among the options).
- **Changed tracking**: each field compares its current draft value against the last-saved baseline; when different, a "Changed" status badge appears next to its label, and a live-region summary above the fields reads e.g. "2 fields changed since your last save."
- **Cancel/Save**: Cancel reverts the draft to the last saved values; Save commits the draft as the new baseline and shows a success toast ("Profile updated"). Both are disabled when there's nothing to act on.

All copy is in English (the app ships Arabic via `ThemeScope`'s `locale`, not hardcoded strings). I ran `audit_snippet` on both the TSX and CSS — score 100, no findings. I can't run the dev server per your instructions, so this hasn't been visually verified in a browser — worth a manual check, especially the RTL and dark-scheme renders.
